idea-plugin.name: Arthas Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
Attach Alibaba Arthas to a running JVM and drive it from the IDE.
  • Pick a local JVM and attach in one click, or connect to an existing Arthas (port-forward / tunnel).
  • Right-click a method: Watch, Trace, Stack, Monitor, Time Tunnel. Right-click a class: Decompile, Search, Hot-swap.
  • Overview: live CPU, heap, threads and GC with the busiest threads.
  • Threads and Classes tabs: sortable thread list with clickable stacks; search loaded classes, see where they came from, decompile, and probe their methods.
  • Probes: several watch / trace / monitor jobs side by side, with trace call trees that highlight the slowest steps.
  • In the editor: probed methods get a gutter icon and live call stats at the end of the line; set limit, condition or a minimum duration before starting.
  • Results are rendered readably in the Arthas tool window; card-like numbers are masked by default.
